page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.6xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 3.1 GHz. The instance features 24 physical cores and 24 vCPUs, operating with 1.0 thread per core. It is configured with 96.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. This virtual machine runs on the KVM hypervisor and does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware. Network connectivity is supported by an 8 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

Benchmark data indicates average performance across multiple test suites. The processor achieves a stress-ng single-core score of 1438.39 and a multi-core score of 23015.19. In memory operations, the instance records a read-only small block cached bandwidth of 1282.13 GB/sec, which drops to 109.43 GB/sec for large block uncached reads, and 48.03 GB/sec for large block writes. The PassMark CPU score is 23637.6, with a database operations score of 8647.45. For specialized tasks, the system processes Redis SET operations at 22.14 million operations per second and achieves a static web serving throughput of 17.13 GB/sec.

With its balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and dedicated CPU allocation, the ecs.hfg6.6xlarge is suited for general-purpose workloads, web serving, and database operations. The lack of local storage requires reliance on network-attached storage, which may impact I/O-heavy workloads. Additionally, the absence of a GPU limits its utility for large-scale deep learning, though it can handle small-scale LLM inference, processing a 135M parameter model at 78.25 text generation tokens per second and a 7B model at 12.72 tokens per second.
